summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running tests, black, or flake8, and without committing. Files: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new; load_decathalon_datalist with four typed parameters, Google-style docstring, os/json only, private _resolve_path helper), monai/data/__init__.py (explicit export line), docs/source/data.rst (Decathalon DataLoader subsection with tilde underline and autofunction entry), tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new; TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels, temp dirs removed in finally). Verified only by measurement: no line exceeds 120 columns. Choices where the spec was silent: non-object top-level JSON raises the missing-key ValueError; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; items are copied, not mutated; missing image/label fields are skipped without error.
